subject: Data Engineering
title: Column-Level Lineage
description: A fast breakdown of Column-Level Lineage for builders.

hook.text: The 'total_revenue' column is wrong. Table-level lineage shows 30 upstream tables. Which column matters?

buildup.text: Column-level lineage traces individual columns through joins, aggregations, and calculated fields.

discovery.text: It tells you exactly which source columns feed into each output column, narrowing debug scope dramatically.

twist.text: Column lineage is hard to track automatically. Complex SQL with CTEs and subqueries challenges parsers.

climax.text: Tools like Marquez and OpenLineage are making column-level lineage achievable at scale.

punchline.text: Table lineage finds the room. Column lineage finds the wire.

quiz.question: How does column-level lineage differ from table-level lineage?
options: It traces individual columns through transformations
